memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome:
- Status: chronic abdominal pain, bloating, diarrhea-predominant symptoms for 2 years; weight 68 kg, waist 88 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm, elevated).
- Plan: start mebeverine 135 mg BD before food; ispaghula husk 5 g OD with water after dinner; loperamide 2 mg SOS after loose stools; advise low‑fat, small frequent meals; avoid spicy, caffeinated foods; review in 8 weeks; due HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: CBC: Hb 12.8 g/dl (12‑16), WBC 6.2 ×10⁹/L (4‑10), platelets 210 ×10⁹/L (150‑400). Stool routine: no ova, cysts, pus cells; pH 6.0. tTG‑IgA: <1.2 U/ml (negative <7).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been taking the medicines as advised. The abdominal pain is milder now, only occasional cramping after lunch. Bloating has reduced; I pass formed stools twice a day. No need for loperamide in the past week.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
mebeverine 200 mg BD before food
ispaghula husk 10 g OD with warm water after dinner
loperamide 2 mg SOS after loose stools (max 8 mg/day)

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome:
- Status: improved pain frequency (2‑3 days/week), waist 86 cm, weight 67.5 kg; reports occasional bloating after heavy meals.
- Plan: continue current mebeverine dose; reduce ispaghula husk to 5 g OD; add probiotic sachet OD; diet: three small meals, avoid fried foods, limit dairy to 1 serving/day; review in 8 weeks; due HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: liver normal size, no focal lesion; gallbladder wall thin, no stones; pancreas unremarkable; no abnormal lymph nodes; bowel loops not distended.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Dr. S. Rao, Gastroenterology, Vikram Hospital, for opinion on persistent IBS‑type symptoms despite first‑line therapy; consider further evaluation for microscopic colitis or bile acid malabsorption.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Gastroenterology opinion: symptoms consistent with IBS‑D; alarm features negative; recommends low‑FODMAP diet trial for 6 weeks, lactose breath test if symptoms persist; continue symptomatic therapy; follow‑up in 8 weeks.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) on 2025-12-01 at 10:30 am.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome:
- Status: after low‑FODMAP diet, pain reduced to 1 day/week, bloating occasional, waist 84 cm, weight 67 kg; no loose stools, loperamide not used.
- Plan: maintain low‑FODMAP diet, re‑introduce one high‑FODMAP food weekly to assess tolerance; continue mebeverine 135 mg BD; stop ispaghula husk; review in 3 months; due HbA1c not applicable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
mebeverine 135 mg BD before food
(Discontinue loperamide SOS; discontinue ispaghula husk)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I occasionally feel bloated after eating rajma or cauliflower; otherwise my bowel movements are regular and I have not needed any rescue medicine in the last month.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Irritable bowel syndrome:
- Status: stable, waist 82 cm (just above female cut‑off), weight 66.8 kg; reports mild bloating after certain legumes, otherwise asymptomatic.
- Plan: continue low‑FODMAP diet with cautious re‑introduction; keep mebeverine 135 mg BD PRN for pain; advise regular physical activity; review in 4 months; due HbA1c not applicable.
